text:
Once upon a time, three little pig brothers named Max, Sam, and Ben lived happily with their mother in a cozy cottage at the edge of a meadow. One bright morning, their mother called them together with a warm hug.

"My dear little ones, you are big enough to build your very own homes now! Go out and make me proud!"

Lazy Max skipped along the path until he spotted a big pile of golden straw. "This is perfect!" he cheered. In less than an hour, Max had thrown together a wobbly straw house.

"Done! Now I can play ALL day!" He tossed his tools aside and danced in the meadow.

Sam found a bundle of sticks by the river. He worked through the afternoon, tying and stacking them carefully. By sunset, Sam had a stick house that he was quite proud of.

"Good enough for me!" he said, doing a little dance inside his new home.

Hard-working Ben chose heavy red bricks. He worked from sunrise to sunset, carefully placing each brick one by one. His back ached and his hooves were tired, but when he finished, his house was SOLID as a rock.

"This will last forever!" Ben smiled proudly.

Then came the Big Bad Wolf, with his big yellow eyes and enormous jaw!

"I'm SO hungry," he growled, licking his lips. He trotted up to Max's straw house. "Little pig, little pig — let me come IN!"

"Not by the hair of my chinny chin chin!" squeaked Max.

The wolf took a huge breath. He HUFFED… and he PUFFED… and he BLEW the straw house down!

Max squealed and sprinted to Sam's stick house. They slammed the door. But the wolf came again! He huffed and puffed and blew the stick house DOWN too!

The two frightened pigs raced to Ben's brick house. SLAM went the door! The wolf arrived, angrier than ever. He huffed and he puffed… and HUFFED and PUFFED with all his might.

But the brick house stood STRONG! Not one brick moved. The wolf huffed until he turned blue!

Furious, the wolf scrambled up onto the roof and squeezed down the chimney! But the clever pigs had lit a roaring fire below.

"YEOOOW!" The wolf shot back out like a rocket, singed and steaming. He ran far, far away and never troubled the three little pigs ever again!

Max and Sam hugged their brother Ben tightly. "We're so sorry for being lazy!" they said. "Thank YOU for your strong house!"

From that day on, the three brothers all lived together in the wonderful brick house, safe, warm, and happy.

🌟 THE END 🌟

💡 Moral: It's always worth working hard and being prepared!
